badReview.title: A brutal review
badReview.body: A creator with a million followers called your product the worst thing they tried this year. The video is taking off.

choices.fixQuietly: Stay silent and fix bugs fast

serverOutage.title: The service is down
serverOutage.body: Your servers could not handle the load. The product has been down for three hours and users are furious.

choices.compensate: Apologize and hand out $400 in credits
choices.ignore: Fix it quietly and explain nothing

viralPost.title: A post went viral
viralPost.body: A user wrote a glowing post about your product and thousands are sharing it.

choices.rushFeature: Rush out what the comments are asking for

adPriceHike.title: Ads got more expensive
adPriceHike.body: The ad platform you rely on has raised its prices.

cashCrisis.title: Out of money
cashCrisis.body: Your balance is negative. If you are not back above zero in 30 days, the company goes bankrupt.

choices.takeLoan: Take a $5,000 loan and repay $7,000 over six months

criticalBug.title: A bug that drives people away
criticalBug.body: So many bugs have piled up that one of them started eating user data. Support gets a new message every hour.

choices.hotfix: Patch it tonight, quick and dirty
choices.properFix: Hire a specialist you know for a day, $300
choices.ignore: They can wait, new features matter more

competitorClone.title: You have been copied
competitorClone.body: A competitor released an almost exact copy of your product and priced it lower.

choices.focusProduct: Stay calm and make the product better
choices.adWar: Flood the market with $500 of ads
choices.rushFeatures: Rush out what they do not have

bigClient.title: A big customer
bigClient.body: A company is ready to pay but wants a custom feature just for itself. Other users do not need it.

choices.politeNo: Politely decline: one product for everyone
choices.bargain: Ask for $2,500 and see if they agree

pressMention.title: You are in the news
pressMention.body: A trade publication mentioned your product in a roundup. The journalist offers to talk in more detail.

hostingBill.title: Hosting raised its prices
hostingBill.body: An email arrived: servers cost more starting this month. There is a surcharge for this month.

choices.negotiate: Write to support and ask for a discount

angelOffer.title: Someone believes in you
angelOffer.body: A private investor has been watching your product and is ready to put in $25,000 for 8% of the company. That is more than you have spent so far.

choices.decline: Decline and stay the sole owner

paymentFreeze.title: Payments are frozen
paymentFreeze.body: The payment service is holding your incoming money "for review". They give no deadline.

choices.wait: Wait: maybe they release it themselves
choices.switchProvider: Spend $250 and switch to another service
choices.tellUsers: Warn users honestly and refund $150 to those affected

founderBurnout.title: Out of strength
founderBurnout.body: You have worked without rest for a long time. Today you stared at the screen for half an hour and wrote nothing.

choices.pushThrough: Grit your teeth and keep going
choices.moreCoffee: More coffee and it will work out

sideGig.title: A gig came up
sideGig.body: A former colleague offers a one-week job. The money would help right now, but the product will have to wait.

choices.bargain: Name double the price and see

userFeedback.title: Users are complaining
userFeedback.body: Dozens of emails have piled up: things are awkward, unclear, or broken. Many say the same thing.

choices.listen: Sit down and fix the most common issue
choices.survey: Run a $150 survey to see the whole picture
choices.ignore: They just did not figure it out

licenseClaim.title: A licence claim
licenseClaim.body: The author of a library you grabbed in a hurry noticed you broke its licence and demands payment.

choices.rewrite: Drop the library and write your own
choices.ignore: Do not reply: maybe he forgets

conference.title: Invited to a conference
conference.body: Organisers of an industry conference offer you a speaking slot. Tickets, travel and lodging are on you.

dataScare.title: Data was exposed
dataScare.body: You found a hole in the code: for three days anyone could read other people's data. Nobody knows whether someone noticed.

choices.audit: Hire an audit for $800 and close the matter
choices.hush: Quietly close the hole and say nothing

featureWave.title: Everyone asks for the same thing
featureWave.body: Hundreds of users are voting for one feature. It was not in your plans.

choices.promise: Promise it and put it on the roadmap
choices.quickHack: Hack it together in a couple of evenings
choices.sayNo: Explain why it will not happen

raiseRequest.title: {{name}}: a talk about pay
raiseRequest.body: {{name}} asks for a meeting and says it plainly: the salary does not match the workload.

choices.promise: Promise to come back to it in a couple of months

poaching.title: {{name}}: an offer from another company
poaching.body: A large company offered your employee a job with a noticeably higher salary. {{name}} is still thinking and tells you honestly.

choices.talk: Have a heart-to-heart about what you are building
choices.letGo: Wish them luck and let go

teamConflict.title: A quarrel in the team
teamConflict.body: Two people cannot agree on how to do a task and have stopped talking. {{name}} writes to you that this cannot go on.

choices.mediate: Bring both together and sort it out
choices.takeSide: Side with the one who wrote
choices.ignore: They are adults, they will work it out

employeeBurnout.title: {{name}}: at the limit
employeeBurnout.body: After weeks of crunch, {{name}} misses deadlines and barely speaks in calls. It looks like burnout.

teamParty.title: A reason to get together
teamParty.body: The team has worked together for a while but never met just for fun. Someone suggested celebrating the last release.

choices.skip: This is no time to celebrate

brilliantIdea.title: {{name}}: an idea
brilliantIdea.body: {{name}} figured out how to rewrite the most tangled part of the code and asks for time to do it.

choices.letBuild: Give the time and stay out of the way
choices.weekend: Let them try on the weekend if they want

prodMistake.title: {{name}}: a mistake in production
prodMistake.body: An update broke the product for some users. {{name}} shipped the change and reported it right away.

choices.helpFix: Sit down together and fix it
choices.addReview: Introduce code review before release ($100 for tools)

courseRequest.title: {{name}}: wants to learn
courseRequest.body: {{name}} found a course in their field and asks whether the company will pay for it.

choices.refuse: Refuse: learn at your own expense

remoteRequest.title: {{name}}: working from home
remoteRequest.body: {{name}} asks to work from home: the commute eats two hours a day.

choices.trial: Try it for a month and see

salaryDelay.title: Nothing to pay salaries with
salaryDelay.body: The account is negative and payday is tomorrow. The team does not know yet.

choices.honest: Tell the team honestly about the delay
choices.ownMoney: Borrow $2,000 from friends and pay on time

devShortcut.title: "{{feature}}": use something ready-made?
devShortcut.body: Half the work is done. For the rest there is a ready third-party library: fast, but you do not know how it works inside.

choices.useLibrary: Take the library: faster, but debt grows

devScope.title: "{{feature}}" keeps growing
devScope.body: It is now clear: doing everything you planned will take longer than it seemed.

choices.cutScope: Cut to the essentials and ship sooner
choices.goldPlate: Polish it properly, even if it takes longer

devTests.title: "{{feature}}": write tests?
devTests.body: The code already works on your machine. The question is whether to spend time on automated checks.

choices.keyTests: Write tests for what matters most

devDesign.title: "{{feature}}" turns out awkward
devDesign.body: You showed a draft to a friend. He looked for the main button for five minutes and never found it.

choices.shipAsIs: Leave it: they will get used to it
choices.askUsers: Show it to five people over $60 of coffee and fix what they say

devOldBug.title: An old bug turned up
devOldBug.body: While working on "{{feature}}" you noticed a bug in something you built earlier. Nobody has seen it yet.

choices.keepGoing: Stay focused: finish what you started
choices.fixNow: Drop everything and fix it properly

devTeaser.title: "{{feature}}": announce early?
devTeaser.body: Users ask what you are working on. The feature is half done.

choices.announce: Name a date, and now make it
choices.earlyBeta: Let the most active users try a rough version

seedRound.title: Seed round
seedRound.body: A fund has seen your numbers and offers $150,000 for 15% of the company. With this money you can build a real team.

choices.decline: Decline: we grow on our own

seriesA.title: Series A
seriesA.body: A large fund offers $1,500,000 for 20% of the company. Deals like this make the news.

storeFeature.title: You are featured!
storeFeature.body: A major platform put your product in its Editors' Choice selection. People are pouring in.

choices.enjoy: Enjoy it and welcome the guests
choices.pushAds: Add $500 of ads while everyone is looking

award.title: An award
award.body: Your product was named the best new service of the year. You are invited on stage.

choices.thankTeam: Dedicate the award to the team

enterpriseDeal.title: A big contract
enterpriseDeal.body: A well-known company wants a yearly agreement for all its staff. The lawyers have already sent the papers.

choices.decline: Decline: the terms are too harsh
